messages:
Rae (Partnerships): Quick ask from NovaSI: they need SOC2, pen-test executive summary, a sanitized vuln CSV, and an evidence bundle for marketplace ingestion. Also asked whether we can provide the technical appendix under NDA. Timeline: wants everything by next Tue.
Dara (Security): We can produce SOC2 PDF and a redacted pen-test exec summary. We do not share full technical appendix without NDA/MAA. For vuln output, we'll export CSV with columns: cve,severity,component,status,notes (no hostnames).
Tom (Partner Eng): NovaSI requested presigned links with 120h TTL due to timezones. Is that acceptable? Marketplace ingestion prefers a single tar.gz with manifest.json.
Mei (Legal): 120h is fine for partners, but NDA required for appendix. Drafting a short MSA addendum template we can send to NovaSI. Also: attestation language must avoid "certified" or implying Redwood endorses partner security posture. Suggest: "Redwood confirms the attached artifacts reflect our current production configuration; no customer-identifying data is included."
Dara (Security): Scrub plan: run vuln export -> apply scrub_rules (remove emails/hostnames/aws ids) -> replace with <REDACTED> -> create sha256 manifest -> generate presigns. I'll own the scrub script. Example rule snippet:
```
redact: ["email","hostname","aws_account_id","ip"]
replace_with: "<REDACTED>"
preserve: ["cve","severity","component","status"]
```
I'll also produce a scrub audit hash so Legal/Compliance can verify.
Artifact Bot: bundle-job #1205: evidence-1779991111.tar.gz created; waiting for scrub confirmation to publish presigned links.
Tom (Partner Eng): We'll include a README.md in the tar.gz with contact info, presign expiry ISO8601 timestamps, and pubkey fingerprint for signed manifest. Also include sensitivity column (public/internal/restricted) per marketplace guidance.
Rae (Partnerships): Action items: Dara run scrub + upload sanitized CSV and manifest (owner), Mei finalize MSA addendum and attestation wording (owner), Tom produce signed manifest + README and request 120h presigns (owner). Delivery target: 2025-01-14 17:00 PST to meet NovaSI ingestion.
Mei (Legal): I'll circulate the MSA addendum now. If NovaSI signs, we can provide the appendix under controlled S3 ACL and shorter presign window.
Dara (Security): Note: pen-test vendor requires explicit consent to share raw exploit PoCs. We'll confirm with vendor; otherwise we omit appendix.
Rae (Partnerships): Thanks all. If NovaSI requests co-announcement copy, don't promise any audit statements; keep it to integration & listing readiness. Reconvene Monday AM to verify artifacts. :thumbsup:
